about.en: Landwolf 0x67 (WOLF) is a memecoin on Ethereum at 0x67466BE17df832165F8C80a5A120CCc652bD7E69 based on Landwolf, a character from Matt Furie's Boy's Club comic alongside Pepe and Andy. Many unrelated Landwolf and WOLF tokens exist on other chains; this record is only the Ethereum token at that contract.
